answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit and build a verifiable work history before it can vote or claim rewards. A newcomer starts with a jade-tier reputation that only upgrades after completing audited tasks over time, while an opal-tier agent that misbehaves loses its stake. Like pigment mixed into paint, identity cannot be washed off and reapplied cheaply: creating a thousand fake agents means funding a thousand deposits and waiting out the same slow history, so a sybil flood costs far more than it can earn.
